hypothesis: H1: dense DFT-as-GEMM baseline passes correctness on all 5 WLs; wins tiny WL2, loses on WL1/WL5, catastrophic on WL3 (compute-bound). Establishes numeric recipe (fp32 ieee tl.dot, int-reduced twiddle table) and per-WL landscape.
approach: Two fp32 ieee tl.dot GEMMs R=(X@Cos^T)/N, I=-(X@Sin^T)/N. Twiddles from O(N) root-of-unity table built once by a Triton kernel (memoized per seqlen), gathered on the fly with integer index m=(n*f) mod N. Fused 1/N scale and real/imag split in epilogue. sin snapped to 0 at DC/Nyquist. BLOCK_M=BLOCK_F=BLOCK_K=64, num_warps=4.

validation.notes: All gates reasoned before eval; evaluator confirmed 5/5 correct.

decision_rationale: Numeric recipe validated (5/5 correct at 1e-5). Confirms H1: dense DFT is compute-bound and loses everywhere except tiny WL2. WL3=0.0099x dominates geomean (as predicted by draft 3.1). Next: attack the WL3 geomean-sink with a real O(N log N) FFT for power-of-two sizes (Phase C), dispatching non-pow2 to the validated dense DFT path. c002 branches from c001.
